scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc --noEmit && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.check: pnpm check:web && pnpm check:rust && pnpm check:python
scripts.check:web: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && node --test scripts/checks/__tests__/*.test.mjs && node scripts/checks/source-layout.mjs && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs src && pnpm test && knip && jscpd src src-tauri/src --min-lines 6 --min-tokens 80 --threshold 1 && pnpm format --check
scripts.check:rust: node scripts/checks/source-layout.mjs && node scripts/checks/capabilities.mjs && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.security:web: pnpm --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org audit --prod --audit-level high && pnpm --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org audit signatures
scripts.e2e:build: vite build --mode e2e && tauri build --no-bundle --features e2e --config src-tauri/tauri.e2e.conf.json
scripts.contracts:generate: cargo run --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin export_space_contracts && uv run --project python --only-group contracts --frozen python scripts/generate_python_contracts.py
scripts.runtime:build: uv run --project python --only-group publication --frozen python -I -B -X utf8 scripts/runtime/build_python.py
scripts.inference:acceptance: uv run --project python --only-group acceptance --frozen python -I -B -X utf8 python/tests/acceptance/report.py
